Intro: Kid, you gotta enjoy your youth. I couldn't wake up this morning because my back's pinched. Then again, I spent the whole night with the Scarab boys.
Makes me think if I'm just too old for this, no? But what's the alternative? Sit by for my turn as goons round up anyone who they think looks spoiled?
Always said that I was going out in a blaze, but my wife used to be here to smack some sense into me. But I have to do my part, any way that I can.
Anyways, get me something that can make me feel young again, yeah? Like…[DISH].
Success: This really takes me back…. Thanks, kid. I needed this. One last push, then I'll rest.
Fail: Good effort, but I think this made me feel older.
Reject: Maybe I can still get to the countryside…
